scope: Read-only local source review of the canonical prediction-profile producer, the opt-in three-teacher cleanfold cache producer, and its pure semantic helper. No tests, SSH, remote actions, model/data payload reads, cache construction, or GPU profile execution were performed by this reviewer.

prediction_profile: Uses the campaign split manifest to select ordered train-fit groups, then exactly the leading 16; FeatureOnlySequences requests features with targets and masks disabled.
Requires the fixed CUDA/FP32 profile invocation with zero loader workers; constructs batch size 16 and passes fixed chunk size 4000.

Validates the checkpoint as raw-112/model-input-211, complete H384x2 GRU with the 23-output auxiliary head and no privileged/readout/quantized/factorized state; profile output remains the raw two-column main prediction.

Disables CUDA matmul and cuDNN TF32, marks the model strict-inference-FP32 so canonical prediction disables autocast, and records scalar timing/memory/output statistics without persisting predictions.

Hashes the predictor and explicit canonical inference-path modules, including model construction, evaluation, input building, compatibility, resources, normalization identity, split/data and profile helper.
cleanfold_t3_cache: Opt-in profile pins ordered S3/S4/S5, strong-family 0.1 metadata coefficients at fixed epoch 2, homogeneous-only output, one 0.8125 multiplier, no cache clipping, and the frozen execution-contract hash/schema/source commit/split.

Checks exact acceptance, model, epoch-2 checkpoint and provenance SHA pins; validates selected provenance recipe fields and fit membership; sidecars must declare campaign fit scope, feature-only export and the split hash.

Requires exact JSON integer row-group identities, exact expected fit membership, and reorders predictions into canonical target-index fit order; evaluation rows are not loaded into the cache construction loop.
Requires prediction arrays to be FP32, shape-aligned and finite, averages in fixed S3/S4/S5 FP32 order, applies the multiplier once, and now rejects nonfinite arithmetic output.
Streams bounded sequence chunks into create-only output paths with output-budget/free-disk gates; opt-in path rejects existing output paths including dangling symlinks.

source_review_findings: The initial row-group coercion, FP32-overflow publication, and dangling-output-symlink issues were corrected in the frozen source. Their final implementations enforce true JSON integers, reject nonfinite combined chunks, and reject symlink output paths before resolution.
No remaining concrete blocker found in the reviewed final source for the frozen profile/cache contract.
